candidate.title: Embed best view renders imported post HTML as raw, enabling XSS from untrusted imported content
reports: no test coverage exists for importremote, ssrf-relevant url handling, or xss/sanitization of imported raw html content
no test coverage for pollfeed, performretrieve, the redis throttle, importremote, or absolutizeurls edge cases (protocol-relative urls, ports, bad uris)

no specs cover sanitization/escaping of imported content — no tests asserting malicious urls/html in feed content are neutralized, nor any controller test for what an attacker-supplied embedurl produces

no test that a referer from a different host is rejected, so the negative access-control branch of ensureembeddable and the uri::invalidurierror rescue are never exercised (spec/controllers/embedcontrollerspec.rb)
